title: Weighing Cloud Services: Concession and Reservation
goal: I can weigh a technology with a concession and a reservation (*Jóllehet … kényelmes, mindazonáltal …*, *Ámbár …, mégsem …*).
I can talk about digital sovereignty and data (*digitális szuverenitás*, *adatlokalizáció*, *technológiai kitettség*).
I can say why a state may keep its data in its own data centres.

sections.title: Unit 18: Digital Sovereignty
body: This unit is about digital sovereignty: who controls a country's data, how critical networks are protected, how surveillance and cryptography work, and what machines can and cannot do.
The unit ends with a short text about the Hungarian mathematician Kalmár László and the question of thinking machines.
